The residential units feature hardwood flooring, bay windows, abundant natural light, built-in cabinetry, and functional layouts. The building also offers separately metered gas and electricity, a Swiftlane entry system, a rear yard, and a roof deck with views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Downtown. Soft-story work has been completed, and the property is compliant with the Fire Alarm Sleeping Room
